Anglican services have been held at Holy Trinity Church in Funchal since this year.
The Synagogue of Funchal was built in the city, but is now disused.
Prince Alexander of the Netherlands died in Funchal during his visit.
Funchal Baptist Church was established in Madeira during this year.
The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints was established on Madeira.

A published paper estimated climate changes affecting the future climate of Funchal.
